# Beacon app files

The files listed below are imported from the Word Links Puzzle Room app bundle.
They are labeled as app-owned so they can be distinguished from the daily puzzle data.

## App-owned web bundle

- `action-buttons.css`
- `age-settings.js`
- `age-slider.css`
- `app-layout.css`
- `app-layout.js`
- `clues.js`
- `crossword.js`
- `custom-puzzles.css`
- `custom-puzzles.js`
- `daily-clock.js`
- `daily.js`
- `dictionary-expanded.js`
- `dictionary-extra-source.txt`
- `dictionary-extra.js`
- `dictionary-source.txt`
- `dictionary-webster-source.txt`
- `dictionary.js`
- `game-directions.css`
- `game-directions.js`
- `game.js`
- `index.html`
- `levels.js`
- `mobile-keyboard.js`
- `mobile-play.css`
- `mobile-play.js`
- `mobile-polish.css`
- `motion.css`
- `motion.js`
- `offline-play.js`
- `offline-store.js`
- `offline.css`
- `presentation.css`
- `service-worker.js`
- `shared-daily.js`
- `styles.css`

## Daily puzzle data

Files under `daily/v1/` are immutable daily puzzle schedule data. They are generated
for the shared daily-puzzle schedule and are not app source files.
